Evidence.description: A structured piece of evidence cited by a business conclusion.
Evidence.title: Evidence

RuleEvaluation.description: One rule's conclusion for one explicit competition/edition/track target.
RuleEvaluation.title: RuleEvaluation

SourceMetadata.description: Immutable provenance and verification state for a competition fact.
SourceMetadata.title: SourceMetadata

EligibilityDecision.description:
Eligibility-specific DecisionResult with target and rule audit trail.

Construction validates internal consistency, not completeness of official
rules. A future Domain Service must establish coverage before ELIGIBLE.
EligibilityDecision.title: EligibilityDecision

SourceMetadata.description: Immutable provenance and verification state for a competition fact.
SourceMetadata.title: SourceMetadata

Evidence.description: A structured piece of evidence cited by a business conclusion.
Evidence.title: Evidence

CompetitionEvent.description:
P1 recorded events and P10 Diff-backed business/coverage interpretations.

P10 observed_at is explicit detection time, not business effective time.
occurred_at is retained only for legacy records. Description is display-only.
No impact, student, notification or workflow semantics.
CompetitionEvent.title: CompetitionEvent

CompetitionPlan.description:
Immutable initial plan for an exact edition or track.

Existing timestamps/version/status remain supplied metadata, not replanning.
Target existence and parent relationships are validated by the caller; this
model checks exact agreement with the supplied P7 target. An audit can be
retained with no needs/milestones. No dates, priorities or actions are inferred.
CompetitionPlan.title: CompetitionPlan

CompetitionTarget.description:
Generic machine identity, not a planning or requirement target.

Repository existence and parent relationships are validated by P9.2, since
this contract contains IDs rather than Competition/Edition/Track objects.
CompetitionTarget.title: CompetitionTarget

EventImpactAnalysis.description:
Supplied outcome against exact Plan context; validators do not infer impact.

Edition-level Event / track Plan and track Event / edition Plan share context,
but relevance alone proves no dependency. Different explicit tracks are disjoint.
Student context has no independent competition target: it binds plan.student_id.
EventImpactAnalysis.title: EventImpactAnalysis

ObservedInstant.description: One window endpoint; an omitted endpoint in a partial window is UNKNOWN.
ObservedInstant.title: ObservedInstant

ObservedTimeWindow.description:
A known window may have partial (or unknown) endpoints per TimeWindow.

Whole-field UNKNOWN says the window itself was not reliably observed.
Missing endpoints do not assert that those endpoints are absent.
ObservedTimeWindow.title: ObservedTimeWindow

ObservedTrackMembership.description:
Complete edition track ID set, including a known empty set.

An incomplete/unobserved set is UNKNOWN, not KNOWN_VALUE(()).
KNOWN_ABSENT asserts absence of the membership fact itself, not zero tracks.
ObservedTrackMembership.title: ObservedTrackMembership

PlanMilestone.description:
Immutable milestone; purpose derives from its referenced PlanningNeed.

source_need_id=None retains P1 general/manual milestone semantics, without
claiming a P7-backed skill action. Timing may be absent or partially known.
PlanMilestone.title: PlanMilestone

PlanMilestonesChange.description: Supplied whole-collection structural change; preserves P8 milestone order.
PlanMilestonesChange.title: PlanMilestonesChange

PlanReference.description: Exact immutable P8 context reference, without student profile contents.
PlanReference.title: PlanReference

PlanStatusChange.description: Controlled operational cancellation, not a general status machine.
PlanStatusChange.title: PlanStatusChange

PlanningNeed.description: Supplied action purpose, justified by P7 facts; never compares skill levels.
PlanningNeed.title: PlanningNeed

ReplanningDecision.description:
Validate supplied action: confirmed > uncertain > proven no-impact.

Multiple analyses and unresolved evidence stay intact. This Contract neither
generates a decision nor promises that a Plan revision is representable.
ReplanningDecision.title: ReplanningDecision

ReplanningEvidence.description: Structured references; full source lineage stays in the supplied Event.
ReplanningEvidence.title: ReplanningEvidence

SkillGapItem.description:
A supplied per-skill conclusion, with separate requirement/student audit.

No numeric gap is defined for the ordinal SkillLevel scale. The compatibility
table only rejects contradictory snapshots; it does not produce a result.
SkillGapItem.title: SkillGapItem

SkillGapPlanningAudit.description:
Small supplied P7 decision projection, not a second gap evaluation.

Caller retains the original decision and supplies its exact target, coverage,
overall status and reasons. Need-local SkillGapItem snapshots retain source
facts/evidence without embedding a complete decision in every need.
SkillGapPlanningAudit.title: SkillGapPlanningAudit

SkillRequirement.description:
Structured skill fact; target/scope belongs to its requirement set.

Skill identity references the existing Skill.id vocabulary. Required
proficiency uses StudentSkill.level. None means a known requirement with
unspecified threshold, never missing requirement data or SkillLevel.UNKNOWN.
SkillRequirement.title: SkillRequirement

SkillRequirementTarget.description: An exact edition or track; no inheritance across targets.
SkillRequirementTarget.title: SkillRequirementTarget

SnapshotDiff.description:
Directed low-level changes only. Not an Event or impact assessment.

Changes are supplied, not inferred. P9.3 verifies them against the referenced
snapshots. Empty changes are legal for observations of unchanged state.
SnapshotDiff.title: SnapshotDiff

SnapshotReference.description: Small audit reference, not a duplicate complete snapshot.
SnapshotReference.title: SnapshotReference

SourceMetadata.description: Immutable provenance and verification state for a competition fact.
SourceMetadata.title: SourceMetadata

TimeWindow.description: A time interval whose endpoints may be unknown.
TimeWindow.title: TimeWindow

TimeWindowChange.description: Whole-window observation or presence change, never an endpoint change.
TimeWindowChange.title: TimeWindowChange

TrackMembershipChange.description:
Known set-to-set changes expose IDs safely; UNKNOWN never asserts removal.

Added/removed member computation belongs to P9.3, not this contract.
TrackMembershipChange.title: TrackMembershipChange

WindowEndpointChange.description: Typed start/end change; unknown endpoint -> known is observation change.
WindowEndpointChange.title: WindowEndpointChange

_EvidenceSnapshot.description: Reuse shared evidence fields while protecting the P7 audit snapshot.
_EvidenceSnapshot.title: _EvidenceSnapshot

PlanDiff.description:
Auditable supplied before/after Plans, not a Diff computation engine.

Structural scope is milestones or controlled target-removal cancellation.
Target/student/needs/audit/horizon stay the same. Revised identity is
lineage-sensitive; no-op reuses the exact old Plan, including metadata.
PlanDiff.title: PlanDiff

RecommendationCandidate.description: Stable identity of one competition, edition, and optional track.
RecommendationCandidate.title: RecommendationCandidate

RecommendationEligibilitySnapshot.description:
Immutable P6 copy of a P5 decision, with its original semantics and audit.

Adds no eligibility fields or rules; inherits all P5 decision invariants.
RecommendationEligibilitySnapshot.title: RecommendationEligibilitySnapshot

RecommendationScoreComponent.description: One future soft-suitability contribution, without a prescribed weight.
RecommendationScoreComponent.title: RecommendationScoreComponent

RecommendationEvaluation.description:
Final result for one candidate, with P5 eligibility kept intact.

A score describes soft suitability on [0, 1], never eligibility probability.
No ranking position, candidate comparison, or scoring formula is defined.
RecommendationEvaluation.title: RecommendationEvaluation

table only rejects contradictory snapshots; it does not produce a result.

Structured skill fact; target/scope belongs to its requirement set.

Skill identity references the existing Skill.id vocabulary. Required
proficiency uses StudentSkill.level. None means a known requirement with
unspecified threshold, never missing requirement data or SkillLevel.UNKNOWN.

SkillRequirementSet.description:
Explicit coverage assessment, not inferred from item count or parsing.

Empty sets represent MISSING only; no implicit 'no skill requirements'.
A skill appears once per exact target, including across REQUIRED/DESIRED,
avoiding ambiguous level/type precedence.
SkillRequirementSet.title: SkillRequirementSet

SkillRequirementTarget.description: An exact edition or track; no inheritance across targets.
SkillRequirementTarget.title: SkillRequirementTarget

_EvidenceSnapshot.title: _EvidenceSnapshot

SkillGapDecision.description:
Gap existence and requirement coverage remain independent facts.

NO_GAP confirms all declared skills (REQUIRED and DESIRED) have specified
thresholds and are satisfied, with COMPLETE coverage. GAP_IDENTIFIED can retain
PARTIAL coverage or unknown student/threshold facts for other skills. An
engine must later compute the supplied status and individual conclusions.
SkillGapDecision.title: SkillGapDecision
